adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB update only targets a single booking row (`prisma.booking.update({ where: { id: bookingId }, ... attendees.createMany ... })`). However, the `CalendarEvent` built for downstream calendar updates/emails always includes `recurringEvent: parseRecurringEvent(booking.eventType?.recurringEvent)`, which (when present) can cause ICS/calendar updates to represent a recurring series. If the system models recurring bookings as multiple booking rows, this would desync persistence (guests added to one occurrence only) from what the invite/calendar update communicates (series-level recurrence). The diff does not show any propagation to other related bookings/occurrences.
